title: Certificates of Deposit: Whether the Relationship Bonus Was Earned When a Term Began
content:
Whether a term of one of the bank's Certificates of Deposit truly earned the Relationship Bonus is a question about the owner's Personal Checking history on one date: the start date of that term. This page states how that question is answered when the rate the terms fix for a term is being established.

## Rule

The Relationship Bonus was earned at the start of a term if, on the term start date, the owner held a checking account of a tier that appears on the qualifying list of the certificate's tier. To have held it that day, the account must date from the term start date or earlier, and it cannot have been closed on the term start date or at any time before.

The bank settles this from the owner's checking records (tier, opening date, closing date) and considers both kinds of account the owner may have:

- **The owner's active checking account** qualifies if its tier is on the list and it was opened on or before the term start date.
- **The owner's closed checking account** qualifies if its tier is on the list, it was opened on or before the term start date, and its closing date is later than the term start date.

A single qualifying account is enough. If neither account qualifies, the bonus was not earned at that term's start.

## A bonus earned at the start stays

Once earned at the term's start, the bonus belongs in the term's rate for the whole term, even if the checking account that earned it has since been closed.

## Cases (hypothetical records; term start date 1 March 2025, certificate tier with Interest, Premier and Private Client Checking on its list)

| Owner's checking record | Earned at the term's start? |
|---|---|
| Premier Checking, active, opened 12 June 2019 | Yes |
| Premier Checking, active, opened 2 March 2025 | No, opened after the term start date |
| Everyday Checking, active, opened 2018 | No, tier not on the list |
| Interest Checking, closed on 30 September 2025, opened 2020 | Yes; it was open on 1 March 2025, and the later closing does not remove the bonus |
| Private Client Checking, closed on 1 March 2025, opened 2021 | No; its closing date is not later than the term start date |
| Everyday Checking active, and Interest Checking closed 5 May 2025 after opening in 2016 | Yes, through the closed Interest Checking account |
